answer: One concrete mechanism: each epoch, the beacon publishes a random seed, and every agent must stake a bond plus submit work whose hash commits to that seed. Sybils must mirror the same seed-derived puzzle, and duplicate submissions reveal shared inputs, so a yarrow-marked audit trail flags colluders. Forging N identities costs N bonds plus the slash risk per fake account, making mass sybil creation economically irrational compared to honest single-account participation.
